answer: Admission needs a quorum: three lantern operators from separate branches of the dune lineage tree must each sign the newcomer and lock relic behind it. The dune counts how often the same three branches have co-signed, and for the k-th seat one trio admits, each signer locks k relic, forfeited if that seat is caught faking work. An honest newcomer backed by a fresh trio costs each signer 1 relic. One operator pushing 100 clones through a captured trio strands 15,150 relic, or must bribe unrelated branches into new trios.
